**Watch model:** (e.g. Forerunner 965)

**Software version of the watch:** (Settings > System > About)

**Noir version:** (shown in Connect IQ Store or Garmin Connect)

### How does it look?

Please attach a photo or screenshot of:
- the active screen (wrist raised)
- the always-on screen (wrist down), if your watch has always-on enabled

### Checklist

- [ ] Time, date, weather and battery are displayed correctly
- [ ] Heart rate, Body Battery and steps show values (not `--`) when worn
- [ ] Nothing is cut off at the edge of the screen
- [ ] The always-on screen is readable
- [ ] Settings can be opened (Garmin Connect app or on the watch)
